findings.title: Fallback lookup hits SiteSetting and can raise
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym on every fallback resolution. If SiteSetting is unavailable during boot, migrations, or tests, or if default_locale is nil/blank, this raises NoMethodError and breaks all I18n lookups, including error pages that need translation. It also adds DB/cache overhead to the translation miss path and risks recursion since translating SiteSetting errors itself needs fallbacks.

findings.title: Translate only preloads current locale, fallback locales stay unloaded
findings.body: I18n.translate ensures load_locale(config.locale) but never loads the fallback chain (site default locale and :en). Outside ApplicationController#set_locale, for example in background jobs, mailers, and rake tasks, a missing key will not fall back correctly because the fallback locale files were never loaded, defeating the new fallback feature.

findings.title: Translation LRU cache key ignores fallback chain
findings.body: The cache key is key plus config.locale plus backend id. When a key is missing in the user locale it resolves via SiteSetting.default_locale and :en, but that fallback result is cached under only the user locale. If the site default locale changes, or translations are added, the stale fallback value is still served from the LRU cache with no invalidation.

findings.title: Replacing I18n.fallbacks with Hash subclass breaks fallback API
findings.body: Assigning FallbackLocaleList, a Hash subclass with only #[] and #ensure_loaded!, to I18n.fallbacks discards the expected I18n::Locale::Fallbacks interface (defaults, mapping, per-locale configuration). Any code or gem that reads or configures I18n.fallbacks.defaults or calls it with arguments will fail or silently misbehave.
